avoid_supplements.name: High-dose alcohol (ethanol)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Abacavir is metabolized by alcohol dehydrogenase; concurrent use increases metabolism and may reduce abacavir levels while increasing toxic metabolites
avoid_supplements.action: Advise patient to minimize or avoid alcohol consumption; counsel on hepatotoxicity risk

caution_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
caution_supplements.mechanism: May induce glucuronidation pathways and potentially reduce abacavir exposure
caution_supplements.action: Monitor viral load; consider alternative if St. John's Wort use is necessary

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May slightly delay abacavir absorption but unlikely to significantly impact bioavailability
caution_foods.action: Abacavir can be taken with or without food; no strict dietary restrictions required

monitoring_notes: Monitor for hypersensitivity reaction (HSR) risk within first 6 weeks; ensure HLA-B*5701 screening completed prior to initiation. Assess liver function and counsel on alcohol avoidance due to shared hepatic metabolism.
